question: Which additional female figures are included among those who know through devotion on earth?
premises: The preceding verses list female figures who know through devotion on earth.
This verse names ulukī, pecakī, sararī, and gūlī as further figures.
The particles vā and tathā mark these names as additional alternatives in the same series.
inference: The owl-woman, peacock-woman, sarari-woman, and guli-woman are likewise included among those who know through devotion on earth.
uncertainties: The exact species or mythic identity of sararī and gūlī is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Likewise, the owl-woman, the peacock-woman, or indeed the sarari-woman, or the guli-woman.
